_pairs: Every non-STRK asset is priced off WBTC/USD: it is the only BTC feed on Pragma with its own dedicated, well-sourced median (8 sources). Run scripts/verify-feeds.mjs before any deploy — the handler refuses a feed with fewer than 3 aggregated sources, so a thinning feed disables swaps rather than degrading them.

outTokens.note: Priced off WBTC/USD. No STRKBTC/USD feed exists on Pragma; WBTC is the closest liquid BTC reference with a sound feed (8 sources).
Priced off WBTC/USD. No SOLVBTC/USD feed exists on Pragma. Note the 18 decimals, unlike WBTC and strkBTC at 8.

_excluded.reason: LBTC/USD exists but aggregates only 2 sources, below the handler's hardcoded minimum of 3. A handler for it would revert on every dispatch, so it is not registered.

deployed._deployedAtBlock: Block at or before which the factory was deployed. Used as the floor for event scans: no receiver can predate its factory, and scanning from genesis costs ~100s of empty pages on mainnet. Written automatically by scripts/deploy.ts.
